title: Journey completeness: every declared journey specified for arrival, loading, empty, error, success, and re-entry
description: Every user journey the project declares is walked and specified for six states: arrival (first render), loading, empty, error, success, and re-entry (returning with existing state or an expired session). Each state has a designed layout; no state falls through to a blank region, an unstyled exception, or a spinner without context.
rationale: Journey gaps are exactly the class of defect the watchpost run3 QA surfaced: functionally sound flows that look abandoned in their non-happy states.
